name: Cutthroat's stun grows by 1 sec per stack of Advantage (#2502)
contract: Cutthroat 800359 (acquirable rank; 705065 is not) reads 'Shoot a powerful arrow that deals Weapon Damage plus 40 and stuns the target for 1 sec. Duration increased by 1 sec per stack of Advantage.' Its effect 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_NORMALIZED_WEAPON_DMG (native), effect 1 is SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL on 805958, and CasterAuraSpell 804329 (Advantage) natively gates the cast on the caster having at least one stack. 805958's effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_STUN, DurationIndex 36 = 1000 ms. aura_ascension_ranger_advantage::Sync (AscensionRangerSecondary.cpp:27-37) keeps the hidden companion 704337 'Advantage Hidden (Warmaster)' stacked to Advantage's own stack count; 704337 effect 0 is ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER/SPELLMOD_DURATION, BasePoints 999 (+1000 ms), classmask matching 805958, and AuraEffect::CalculateAmount (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:654) multiplies that base by the companion's own stack amount, so the live SPELLMOD_DURATION on 805958 is already 1000/2000/3000 ms at 1/2/3 Advantage stacks (confirmed with the spell_modifier probe, no cast needed) and Aura::CalcMaxDuration (SpellAuras.cpp:807-819) applies it when 805958 is freshly created, giving 1000 base + 1000 per stack with no extra script. 805958's Mechanic is 12 (MECHANIC_STUN), which Unit::ApplyDiminishingToDuration (Unit.cpp:12665, 'Some diminishings applies to mobs too (for example, Stun)') diminishes on repeat applications to the SAME target within its 15 s reset window (Unit.cpp:12589), at 100%/50%/25%; this scenario therefore measures each stack count against its OWN fresh dummy so Diminishing Returns never contaminates the raw per-stack measurement. Expected raw duration: ~2000 ms at 1 stack, ~3000 ms at 2 stacks, ~4000 ms at 3 stacks, already true on a native build with no #2502 fix script. 800359 has a 5-30 yd range (min range 5 yd); every fixture creature needs an explicit distance (default is 0, inside the minimum range, which fails the cast with SPELL_FAILED_TOO_CLOSE/128).
